referenceKind: NCEP-NCAR Reanalysis 1 monthly 2m air-temperature climatology; not raw observations

sourceGrid.areaWeight: 94-point Gaussian quadrature weight per source cell; equal longitude widths cancel

units.longitude: degrees east in [0, 360); source coordinates, not a generated-map transform
units.monthlyTemperature: monthly climatological mean 2m air temperature in C, not instantaneous or land-surface temperature

period.aggregation: Day-weighted monthly-climatology approximation, not recovered daily data

sourceTime.interpretation: Synthetic year-0001 month labels, not dated observations; relative offsets establish Jan-Dec order. Absolute negative times are not decoded as proleptic Gregorian dates.

calendarInterpretation: Gregorian 1991-2020 month-day weights retain the annual fixture's explicit aggregation convention; the source time variable has no calendar attribute.
solarAlignment: none; monthly intervals are retained, but no solar phase, dated ephemeris or month-center instant is invented
